title: Fresh-seed review (4, 256^2) of c46's hunting-predator ecology: predators added at t=2000 crash the prey (56 -> 7) and the populations swing (prey 66 -> 18-29, predators 58-82) to t=12000, predators divide (21 persistent splits, generation 2) as separate droplets; but prey divide less with predators (4 persistent splits) than in the twin, which grows by division (56 -> 87, 29 persistent splits); E fork not run
summary: Ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 4 with labkit (256^2, 120 frames, t=12000, --lineage-k 5) and its predator-free twin (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window). Prey condensates (cyan) form from noise; predator material added at t=2000 condenses into small orange droplets that eat the prey: prey components every 1000 t 13, 50, 56, 7, 26, 66, 47, 29, 18, 27, 23, 27, 28; predators 0, 0, 0, 58, 59, 71, 82, 71, 79, 75, 76, 69, 72. Predators: 21 persistent splits (K=5), generation 2, merge/split 0.08. Prey: 4 persistent splits, generation 1. Twin: prey 3, 50, 56 (flat to t~7000), then 60, 68, 76, 82, 87, growing by dumbbell division (29 persistent splits, generation 1), no cycles.

observations.S: pack256/seed4/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain (predators added as noise at t=2000)
observations.I: pack256/seed4/sheet.png t=2600-12000: predator droplets are separate small bodies, apart from the prey droplets they eat
observations.X: twin256/seed4: prey grow monotonically 56 -> 87 without predators; with predators prey crash to 7 at t~3000, recover to 66 and settle at 18-29 (species n_comp in metrics.json); sign: predators lower prey, prey feed predators

seeds_run.result: S, I, X and predator division pass (21 persistent splits, gen 2); prey division thin (4 persistent splits, gen 1) and lower than the twin's 29; E not tested

verdicts.limitation: D: predators divide (21 persistent splits, generation 2) but prey reproduce less with predators than without (4 vs 29 persistent splits), so 'interacting populations that reproduce' rests on the predators; most new prey appear by nucleation, as the claim says. I did not run the fuel-cut fork, so E is unchecked by me. One seed; the twin is not a frozen emulsion on this seed but a slowly dividing one.
